structural_change: HBM-IDX6 FAN32 (10-20) successor of hidx_sel_s3c_a: same ports / timing / arithmetic (lockstep-equivalent to the s3 original), every register and combinational net <= 32 actual load pins by replicated state (kept P1 copies per consumer family, per-chunk kept flags, one-edge-ahead one-hot rotate selects from replicated fill state, per-chunk pack prefix copies, regional reset leaves). Predecessor failed the mandatory native32 census (s3q 497 drivers / max 1788; s3c d_go 61, reset leaf 115). L2H-IDXSEL s3 (LEAD3-HBM route B 10-19): the ctl child tile of the landed IDX selector cluster (control-word pin flops, reset landing, choose pipeline on the returned histogram stream, fault); 43.2 x 54.0; S face = die control ports, W/E = the W/E quadrants' landed ret/ties/qf, N = cw/thr rings.
